WA, Perth metro delivery only; Emma confirmed 2026-08-17 that the boundary published on their site is accurate. In person visitable from Perth (Guildford, ~20 min from CBD). Contact is Emma. 859 products tracked, 225 in stock at 2026-08-17 (post DEC-301 filter). 127 clicks / 119 visitors in the 90d to 2026-08-13. BARE ROOT MODEL (Emma, 2026-08-17 visit; corrected by Benedict same day). They order bare root stock in around June. It goes first to a pre-registration list, then anything uncollected after 2 weeks is released to the general public, and whatever still does not sell is potted up and sold on as potted stock. Most bare root is spoken for before the public ever gets a chance at it.

Crucially, those lines DO appear on their website, they just only ever show as out of stock. So we hold them: 161 bare root lines at 2026-08-17, 102 of them out of stock, including Cox's Orange Pippin, Angelina Burdett, Coe's Golden Drop, Nijisseiki and the Minnie Royal/Royal Crimson cherry multigrafts. This is a feature, not a gap. Our variety pages give a collector a second place to be notified from, independent of Guildford's own registration list, and that notification surface is the thing to upsell to nurseries later.

Do NOT ask Emma for registration volumes. They live in a spreadsheet with thousands of rows and she is not going to share them.

They deliberately do not import some deciduous stock that is too susceptible to pests, shot hole borer being the live Perth problem. It does not generally affect fruit trees, but it does affect much of the deciduous range they would otherwise bring in. Absence of a variety at Guildford is sometimes a policy decision, not a stock-out.

Stock levels are kept deliberately accurate: an online-vs-shop conflict causes real problems when the last plant sells twice. Treat Guildford availability data as high quality.

Emma may be able to supply stock listings directly instead of us scraping. Not yet specified as to format or cadence.

COLD 2026-09-17 (Benedict): no reply to the 2026-08-20 SMS. The stock feed is NOT wanted: Benedict told her the site already gives us everything. Not chasing for now.

THE TWO SMS QUESTIONS, checked against their live Store API on 2026-09-17 (1,900 products):
- 'How many are left' is not a switch. None of their fruit trees track a quantity online: 45 of 45 in-stock fruit trees have stock management off (e.g. Loquat Nagasaki-wase, Blueberry Premier, Apricot Multi Graft Glengarry/Newcastle). The only quantity-tracked lines in fruit-ish categories are Eden Seeds packets, netting and fertiliser. Their 392 tracked products all read 'In stock' and none reads 'Only N left', so the store is set to never show quantity. Flipping that setting would show counts on seed packets, not trees. Getting tree counts means changing how they manage stock, which they keep accurate by hand. Do not re-ask.
- 'Coming back or dropped' is partly answerable from our own history. 139 of 167 bare root lines seen since 2026-03-05 were in stock at some point, mostly July-August (2,821 in-stock line-days in July). 28 never were, e.g. Apple Cox's Orange Pippin Semi Dwarf (0 of 43 days) and Cherry Multi Graft Minnie Royal/Royal Lee (0 of 167). After the 2027 season, a line that sold in 2026 and does not return answers itself. The residual question is only the 28 never-seen lines, which could be dropped OR entirely taken by the pre-registration list.

CORRECTION to the BARE ROOT MODEL note above: 'they just only ever show as out of stock' is not what the data shows. Most bare root lines DO show in stock online for a while (the public release), so restock alerts on Guildford bare root can and do have something to fire on.
